summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed Form 6-K disclosing a daily share repurchase under its buy-back program announced on 5 August 2026. On 11 August 2026, HSBC purchased 1,340,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of GBP 15.3194 and 498,800 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$162.1215, for approximately US$61.0 million total consideration since program commencement. Shares were purchased for cancellation via BNP Paribas as principal. A full trade breakdown is available via RNS link. Watch for ongoing daily repurchase announcements and cumulative buy-back progress toward program completion.
